subject: [PATCH 3/6] mm/memory-failure: keep the page online while handling it

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch modifies the memory-failure handling in the Linux kernel to keep a page online while it is being handled, preventing potential faults and crashes due to the page going offline during processing. The change involves moving the get_online_mems() call earlier in the code to ensure that the page remains online until its use is complete. This fix addresses issues with memory failure handling, particularly when dealing with poisoned pages, and has been tested to prevent faults and maintain lockdep cleanliness.
